visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and bangs, wearing a white shirt, speaks excitedly into the camera in a room with shelves displaying various decor. She holds up bags and shopping containers. (2) The camera transitions to a series of close-up shots showing hands unwrapping mineral specimens from bubble wrap and tissue. A tabby cat intermittently appears, sniffing and interacting with the crystals. (3) Detailed close-ups reveal various minerals: garnet boxes, pink amethyst geodes, clear quartz with green inclusions, and cubic pyrite. The lighting is bright and even, accentuating the facets and colors of the stones. (4) The woman demonstrates placing a large pyrite specimen into a wooden and glass display cabinet. The video concludes with a wide shot showing the entire collection of newly unboxed minerals arranged beautifully on a table.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A domestic indoor setting with cream-colored walls. Shelves in the background contain small decorative objects, crystals, and books. A wooden display cabinet and a magazine are also visible.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Cheerful female narration begins with a high pitch and excited tone, supported by a gentle acoustic guitar melody in a major key. Sharp, high-frequency rustling of plastic shopping bags acts as a rhythmic accompaniment. (2) Each new specimen revealed is preceded by the textured, broadband sound of bubble wrap popping and tissue paper crinkling. The narrator's speech rate is fast and enthusiastic, reflecting high arousal. (3) Subtle percussive thuds are heard as various minerals are placed on the table surface. The music remains steady, maintaining a light and positive atmosphere. (4) The narrator’s voice exhibits rising intonation as she presents the largest pyrite piece. The sound of a wooden cabinet latch clicking shut marks a technical phase shift, followed by a final musical crescendo and a smooth fade-out as the narration concludes.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Series of Specimens -> Climax/Largest Piece -> Final Display
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share and document a collection of mineral specimens purchased at an exhibition, showcasing their beauty and unique characteristics to an audience interested in crystals and collectibles.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While brands like Hizashi Crystal are visible on stands, the video presents as a personal hobbyist unboxing/vlog rather than a paid promotion.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The presence of a cat adds a casual, domestic 'vlog' feel to the unboxing process, making the technical subject matter more relatable.
